name: Robust Mesh Voxelization via Exact Predicates
definition: A function that takes a Piecewise Linear Complex (PLC) and options, and produces a VoxelGrid containing an occupancy grid and/or a signed-distance field (SDF).
summary: Robust Mesh Voxelization via Exact Predicates is a mesh-native voxelizer that uses Shewchuk's exact predicates to avoid epsilon-ray speckle and ensure robust classification without tessellation.
